item.text: {"name":"20-day ETF trend persistence","family":"trend","lookback":20,"mechanism":"Hypothesis: gradual investor adjustment causes trends to persist in US- and Canadian-listed equity ETFs. For each ETF, after each daily close, compare its split- and dividend-adjusted close with the mean of its latest 20 daily adjusted closes, including today. Hold long from the next open if above the mean; otherwise hold cash. Reevaluate daily, trading only when the signal changes.","failure_condition":"On a prespecified out-of-sample period and ETF universe, the hypothesis is falsified if the average next-open-to-following-open total return after above-mean signals is no greater than after other signals, measured in each ETF's trading currency."}
